Auraline Premium ANC_AU90.positive_summary: Customers consistently praise the AU90 for its strong audio performance, especially rich bass, crisp highs, and an overall balanced soundstage. Battery life and ANC are major strengths, with many saying it lasts all day, charges quickly, and blocks ambient noise extremely well. Comfort, solid build quality, reliable mic performance, and suitability for commuting and work-from-home use also stand out.
Auraline Premium ANC_AU90.negative_summary: The main complaints focus on inconsistency: a small group of users report disappointing or hollow sound, weak bass, and Bluetooth dropouts. Some also feel the headset is poor for exercise or windy environments, while others question the value for money and say the build can feel cheap or fragile. Battery and ANC issues appear only occasionally but are worth monitoring.
Auraline Premium ANC_AU90.improvements: Improve consistency in sound tuning and Bluetooth stability so more users get the premium experience promised by top reviews. Strengthen suitability for active and outdoor use by improving wind handling, fit security for exercise, and perceived durability. Also address value concerns by tightening quality control and ensuring build quality matches the premium price positioning.
